answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the velvet of the next round. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, revoked by a single upheld challenge.
